uncertain.rule: owner decision: the error code is cleanup_debt; RouteView keeps the uncertain state

busy.rule: owner decision: lock held; the app retries after a pause

precondition_failed.surfacing: internal: nothing changed, the core re-observes and re-plans; only when retries are exhausted does an app see provider_unavailable. Never surfaced directly.
